## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The optional JSON destination should preserve a following `--junit` flag; currently, that valid combination fails. This review read both changed files and all available tests; no tests were run.

## Changes
The pull request adds optional JSON destinations and a function that writes selected reports, with tests for standalone JSON and JUnit arguments.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:16 — correctness — Preserve following flags when JSON has no path — For `["--json", "--junit", "report.xml"]`, you consume `--junit` as the JSON destination and then raise `ValueError("unknown option: report.xml")`. Both the destination assignment and index increment check only whether another argument exists, without checking whether it is an option. — Users cannot request default JSON output followed by an explicit JUnit destination. — Fix: Consume the following argument only when it is a path; otherwise retain `results.json` and process the following flag normally.
